v5.9.15 - Discord live status and solver alerts
Features --- - Parent farming live Discord embeds now show energy and mood - Race loss alerts when a smart-solver race does not finish 1st - Win-rate guard alerts when P(win) is below the guard floor - New Discord Settings toggles for race and guard alerts (default on)
Includes v5.9.14 Smart Race Solver energy, win-rate guard, and live preview.
